commands.name: sales
commands.description: Query and maintain sales resources

commands.name: invoice
commands.description: Query and create sales invoices

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a sales invoice from direct options (one line through --item-code, or repeatable --line) or a SalesInvoiceCreateRequest JSON file. The salesperson defaults to the salesPerson config setting, then to the API user's sales person. --post posts the invoice, which is irreversible and requires --yes

options.name: --currency
options.description: Currency code; DK Plus derives it when omitted

options.name: --description2
options.description: Secondary description of the single line

options.name: --dimension1
options.description: First dimension of the single line

options.name: --discount-amount
options.description: Discount amount of the single line (e.g. 2.5)

options.name: --discount-percent
options.description: Discount percent of the single line (e.g. 2.5)

options.name: --due-date
options.description: Due date (yyyy-MM-dd); DK Plus derives it when omitted

options.name: --file
options.description: SalesInvoiceCreateRequest JSON file; it replaces the direct options and cannot be combined with them

options.name: --item-code
options.description: Item code of a single-line invoice

options.name: --line
options.description: One invoice line as key=value pairs separated by ';' (repeat for more lines), e.g. "item-code=A;quantity=4;unit-price=1000". Keys: item-code (required), quantity, unit-price, description, description2, memo, warehouse, reference, discount-percent, discount-amount, total, dimension1, prices-include-tax. Double-quote a value to include ';' or '='; a value starting with '{' is one JSON SalesInvoiceLineRequest

options.name: --original-prices
options.description: Keep the supplied line prices instead of the product prices

options.name: --prices-include-tax
options.description: The single line's unit price includes tax

options.name: --quantity
options.description: Quantity of the single line (e.g. 2.5; default 1)

options.name: --sales-person
options.description: Salesperson number; defaults to the salesPerson config setting, then DK Plus uses the API user's sales person

options.name: --total
options.description: Requested total of the single line (e.g. 2.5)

options.name: --unit-price
options.description: Unit price of the single line (e.g. 2.5)
